title: Fix bugs identified in repository review
description: All six review findings are confirmed issues and fixed locally. Findings 1-2 tracked in gpu-power-monitor-9se. Finding 3 repro: unchanged broadcast raises RuntimeError when clients change during suspended drain; fixed with client snapshot, concurrent bounded sends, and transport abort for stalled/broken peers; 3 regression cases pass. Finding 4 repro: headless UI retained PID 123 after three empty snapshots, with and without tracked stress process; fixed by replacing process list on every snapshot; both cases pass. Finding 5 repro: actual daemon reader path consumes mocked frame but power-limit action never opens modal; fixed with lazy UI-owned NVML control connection, cleanup and retry; tests verify cancellation, apply, reuse, failed-open retry and direct-mode ownership. Finding 6 repro: 10 model-threshold regression cases failed in daemon/direct readers (missing warnings or wrong severity); fixed using selected thermal profile and shared snapshot/alert generation. Full suite: 116 tests pass; git diff --check clean. Validation uses simulated clients, mocked NVML/CUDA and headless UI; no real power-limit changes or GPU stress runs. No finding marked Not An Issue.
close_reason: All remaining findings (3-6) reproduced before fixing, then verified individually. Full suite passes: 116 tests. All changes local.
